_doc: Starting-point look for trailer_edit.py (redo on the final renders; everything stays live in Resolve). grade: an ASC CDL per time of day on node 1 of every picture clip, clips in Sunset/Night/... colour groups. finishing: the Fusion chain on the full-length LOOK adjustment clip (V4) — 'less CGI, less flat': soften the CG edge a touch, Film Look Creator (filmic contrast + highlight rolloff, lifted toned blacks, warm-high/teal-low split tone, halation, bloom as diffusion, a hint of flicker and gate weave; its own grain off), glint glow, a faint anamorphic streak on the brightest points, slight barrel distortion + edge chromatic aberration, vignette, then 35 mm-ish Film Grain weighted to the shadows. vhs: adjustment clips on V5 over the cut events flagged "vhs" (MAIN: the R6 intro + title), else one disabled full-length clip: softened resolution, AnalogDamage (tape noise, chroma bleed/offset, tracking wobble), stronger fringing, a scanline hint — enable it for selected passages (e.g. the intro build or the title). letterbox: the disabled 'LETTERBOX 2.39 (off)' clip (V6); enable for the 2.39:1 version. The master-bus limiter/glue compressor is not reachable by the scripting API: Fairlight > Bus 1 > Dynamics by hand (limiter -1 dBTP, 2:1 glue, slow attack). Inputs by Fusion input ID; numbers are deliberately light (user: the first vignette was a dark tunnel; the first finish that actually rendered (2026-09-15) measured: Vignette -11 % at the corners with Blend 0.45 (-25 % without), LensBarrel edge REPLICATE (CONSTANT pulled black into the corners), FilmLook -6 luma, everything subtle — go lighter when in doubt), to be judged to be judged on the 1080p renders. vhsRamp: the treatment mixes in/out over inFrames/outFrames with a blur + fringe spike (a quick tracking glitch). VHS: AnalogDamage's clean-VHS preset simulates a 4:3 CRT scan (black side bars, a shifted/tiled picture) and hot dials: scan off, dials near neutral, the tape signal kept.
